title: Let's Not Open That
gist_ar: مشهد مليان تعبيرات مجازية: التعبيرات نفسها هي اللي بتوقف التفكير.

before_listening.en: A scene thick with idiom. Listen for what the idioms are being used to avoid.
before_listening.ar: مشهد مليان تعبيرات مجازية. ركّز على التعبيرات بتستخدم لتجنّب إيه.

segments.speaker: Hala
segments.text: So we're calling it a grey area and moving on. That's where we landed.

segments.speaker: Fouad
segments.text: It is a grey area. I don't think anybody's pretending otherwise.

segments.speaker: Hala
segments.text: Is it, though. Because a grey area is when the rule doesn't tell you what to do, and the rule here is crystal clear. It's just expensive.

segments.speaker: Fouad
segments.text: Well, quite. And if we get into it we'll open a right can of worms, and then we're into three years of it.

segments.speaker: Hala
segments.text: That I'll grant you. But notice what you just did. You said the answer would be inconvenient, not that the question was hard. Those are different animals.

segments.speaker: Hala
segments.text: I'm reading the minutes. Because 'grey area' goes in the file as unresolved-ish and generates nothing, whereas 'we decided not to look' gets a review date. One of those comes back and the other doesn't, and we both know which is which.

segments.speaker: Fouad
segments.text: You'd have us write 'we decided not to look'? That's a hostage to fortune.

segments.speaker: Hala
segments.text: It's the truth, though, isn't it. And I'd rather hand a hostage to fortune than kick this down the road for somebody who wasn't in the room.

segments.speaker: Hala
segments.text: Look. I'm not trying to reopen it today. I'm saying pick your words on purpose. If we're parking it, say parked, and put a date on it. If we're dropping it, say dropped, and say why. Either's defensible. What isn't is a phrase that means whatever the next person needs it to mean.

segments.speaker: Fouad
segments.text: Parked. Six months. I'll draft it.

segments.speaker: Hala
segments.text: Thank you. And put your name on the draft, not the committee's.

segments.speaker: Hala
segments.text: Because in six months somebody will ask who parked it, and 'the committee' isn't a person you can put that question to.

segments.speaker: Fouad
segments.text: ...That's a fair point, annoyingly. Fine. My name on it.

gist_question.q: What are the idioms being used to avoid?
options: Naming the individual colleague who would be held responsible for the outcome
Admitting the rule is clear and applying it would be costly
Between a grey area and a review date
Between parking and dropping a decision
Between the answer being inconvenient and the question being hard

questions.q: Why does the wording matter administratively?
options: 'Grey area' generates no follow-up; a decision gets a review date

questions.q: What does she say is not defensible?
questions.q_ar: قالت إيه اللي مش ممكن الدفاع عنه؟
options: Parking a decision for six months
A phrase that means whatever the next person needs it to mean
Dropping the matter altogether, as long as the reason for doing so is minuted

glossary.word: to kick something down the road
